messages:
alex: Quick idea — we should standardize an API-level error taxonomy for all inference surfaces (chat, completions, embeddings, rerank, tool calls). Small, predictable set of machine codes + human message, plus optional fields for retry hints and model/variant.

maria: Agree. Current inconsistency is causing SDK logic to be messy (different retry heuristics per endpoint).

jamal: Key ask from customers: clear distinction between transient vs permanent errors. We need machine-readable `code` values, not just HTTP.

leo: Proposal draft: map to HTTP status and add stable `error.code` strings. e.g. 429 -> RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, 503 -> MODEL_UNAVAILABLE, 400 -> INVALID_INPUT, 422 -> STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_INVALID, 409 -> VERSION_CONFLICT, 502 -> BACKEND_ERROR, 504 -> INFERENCE_TIMEOUT. Include `retry_after` when applicable.

anna: For function/tool calling surface we should add TOOL_ERRORS: TOOL_NOT_FOUND, TOOL_AUTH_ERROR, TOOL_EXECUTION_FAILED, TOOL_TIMEOUT. Also return `tool.name` and `tool.exit_code` when available.

alex: Important: define which errors are idempotent-safe to retry automatically in SDKs. My suggestion: auto-retry for RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED (with backoff, honoring retry_after), MODEL_UNAVAILABLE only for read-only requests and when fallback model exists, and INFERENCE_TIMEOUT only for non-streaming endpoints. No auto-retry for INVALID_INPUT, STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_INVALID, VERSION_CONFLICT.

maria: +1. Also specify header conventions: X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, Retry-After (seconds). And response body keys: `error.code`, `error.message`, `error.details` (array or string), `error.retry_after` (seconds), `error.meta` (map) — SDKs can surface those.

jamal: For streaming endpoints: how do we signal mid-stream failures? e.g., model OOM or server restarts. We should stream a final error event with same `error` object and a final HTTP status when connection closes.

devex: Implementation note for SDKs: treat streaming error event as terminal; expose raw error object and a normalized exception type. Provide default backoff policy: exponential with jitter, cap at 30s, respect `retry_after` if present.

leo: Launch criteria checklist (proposal):
- Spec written and approved by product + eng (this thread)
- SDKs (js/py/go) implement normalized error types + auto-retry rules
- Console surfaces per-route quota/rate-limit charts and Retry-After logs
- E2E tests: simulate 429, 503, 504, tool errors for each surface
- Canary rollout to 5% traffic with metric gates (errors, latency, retry volume)

anna: Also need docs for customers: mapping table of code -> meaning -> suggested client action. Example entries: 
`{ code: "RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED", http: 429, recommended: "backoff and retry, honor Retry-After" }`

alex: Edge decision: For model-level unavailability we add `error.model` and `error.variant_suggested` fields. If automatic fallback occurs, include `meta.fallback_to` with model id. That keeps client aware.

maria: Security: do not leak PII in `error.details`. Add linting to server to scrub user content from error messages.

jamal: Prioritization: MVP for next release (target: next sprint) should cover chat/completions + embeddings + tool call basic codes. Rerank and structured-output detailed codes can follow in sprint+1.

devex: SDK breaking changes? Keep wire format backward-compatible: add `error.code` additive. If clients rely on parsing text messages, docs must call that out as unsupported.

sre-bot: Incident note: previous outage surfaced 503s without `model` field which made troubleshooting slower. Please ensure `model` is required for 503 and 504.

leo: Ops ask: emit events to tracing when fallback happens: span tag `redwood.fallback.model`. That helps SLO tracking.

anna: Final smaller items: standardize a `client_hint` boolean to indicate whether client should attempt local fallback (e.g., degrade to cached response).

alex: I'll draft a concise spec PR with examples and a mapping table. Assigning reviewers: @maria, @leo, @jamal, @devex. Target: PR by EOD tomorrow.

maria: Thanks — will review. quick note: include examples for `function_call` failure payloads and expected SDK errors.

jamal: I'll add test harness cases for simulate-tool-timeouts and model fallback paths.

leo: I'll add the header and metric schema changes to the infra deck.

devex: Once PR is up I'll start SDK stubs.

anna: +1 

alex: cool — rolling this into the roadmap item `api-error-contracts-v2`. Keeping this thread as the decisions log.

sre-bot: Deploy bot: canary rollout scheduled after docs + SDKs: 2026-05-10T09:00Z (placeholder).

alex: End — will post PR link here when ready.
